title: Primitives
description: Scalar domain types shared across events and the REST surface. Defined once so that a change to, say, the bid range is a one-line change rather than a search-and-replace across twelve files.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. Always serialised in UTC with a trailing Z. The system has exactly one timezone and it is UTC; local time never enters the domain.

CustomerId.description: Opaque customer identifier. Deliberately a stub: there is no authentication or multi-tenancy in this system, and the README says so as a scope cut rather than leaving it to be discovered.

SatelliteId.description: Stable internal satellite identifier, e.g. SENTINEL-1A. Distinct from norad_id because a satellite outlives any particular TLE.

NoradId.description: NORAD catalog number, as it appears in the TLE. The join key back to Celestrak.

Credits.description: Bid or value in integer credits. Integers, not floats: allocation compares and sums these constantly, and float comparison in a tie-break is a bug waiting for a specific input. There is no settlement — nothing charges these.

PriorityTier.description: Customer class. The tier multiplier and the ageing curve that turn (tier, bid, age) into an effective value are deliberately NOT part of this contract — they live in planner policy configuration, so fairness can be re-tuned without versioning a schema, and so clients cannot game a published formula.

DurationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds. Fractional seconds are meaningful here — slew times and dwell times are sub-second-sensitive.

DurationMillis.description: Elapsed wall-clock milliseconds, for operational metrics carried on events.

TimeWindow.description: A half-open interval [start, end). JSON Schema cannot express end > start, so that check lives in the validating adapter on both sides of every boundary — noted here so its absence is not mistaken for an oversight.
